stemMd:
A musician can perform a difficult passage alone at a steady tempo but struggles when accompanying a singer who varies the timing. This suggests that mastering the passage's notes is not identical to mastering ______.

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.label: A
options.textMd: a rule that tempo can never change

options.label: C
options.textMd: the responsiveness needed to adapt the passage during ensemble performance

options.label: D
options.textMd: the ability to produce any musical sound

explanationMd: The contrast isolates adaptation to another performer. Technical execution in fixed conditions does not by itself establish the capacity to respond when timing changes.

distractorRationale.d: The musician can already perform alone.
distractorRationale.b: Knowing names is unrelated to adapting timing.
distractorRationale.a: The challenge arises precisely because tempo varies.
